title: Persistent function code across conversation
hypothesis: A session-stored Mirror code reuses a task function over multiple turns with no more than 5pp quality loss vs repeating direct ICL and a lower total of serialized state plus prompt-context bytes.
physical_object: one frozen GPT-2 session with persistent code state
mirror_coordinate: m_session written once from task demonstrations and reused over turns
logical_multiplicity: persistent task behavior across a multi-turn session without repeating demonstrations

task.type: synthetic multi-turn procedure x domain queries

development.allowed: test session reset and accounting only; code rank fixed from MA520 (rank4/K8)

storage.authority: actual serialized persistent state plus cumulative prompt context bytes
paid_objects: all prompt tokens repeated or amortized

success_gate: Direct ICL and explicit-FV execution above chance; session-code mean accuracy within 5pp of repeated ICL over all 8 turns; total state+context bytes lower than repeated ICL.
failure_gate: Valid ICL task but persistent code fails quality, retention, or total byte gate.
not_established_gate: Direct ICL or explicit-FV execution at/below chance; persistent utility cannot be judged.
boundaries: Synthetic GPT-2 session task only; not persistent natural skills.
Include every saved code and repeated prompt byte.
Session longevity is measured by 8 turns only.
